articles.title: Ukrainian suspect hunted by police after Monaco bomb attack was 'disguised as a man'
articles.description: Officials believe the suspect may not have acted alone and spent days casing out the scene of the attack.

articles.title: Polish PM warns critical months ahead in face of Russian threat
articles.description: Tusk says Poland is preparing for "various" scenarios after media reports of a planned Russian attack.

articles.title: 'Most massive' Russian attack on Kyiv kills at least 30
articles.description: The latest barrage deployed the largest number of weapons on the capital and hit locations over a wide area.

articles.title: MPs call on foreign secretary to sanction Netanyahu over 'torture' of Palestinian civilians
articles.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his justice minister should be sanctioned by the British government, dozens of MPs have urged the UK foreign secretary.
